verdicts.reason: A keeps the original two-column structure and the phone, but the SOLSTICE wordmark now sits below the headline, the headline is jammed against the top edge, and the two badges have been inflated into full-width pills the same size as the CTA. 'SUMMER ONLY' in bright orange actually outweighs 'Find It Near You', so the call to action no longer stands out. B has a stronger headline, but it breaks into three lines with 'back' left alone on the last one, and the green circle floats behind the text, detached from the phone. Its subcopy leaves 'sweet.' alone on a line, the CTA and badges shrink to tiny stacked pills (with 'BACK BYDEMAND' missing a space), and the right column is cramped while the lower left is empty. B is the less coherent resize.
